from collections import Counter
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    special_rows=[]
    anomaly_cols=set()
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        mode = Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        if mode != bg and any(v != mode for v in row):
            special_rows.append((i, mode))
            anomaly_cols.update(j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v != mode)
    xs=sorted(anomaly_cols)
    if len(xs)>=2:
        step=reduce(gcd,(b-a for a,b in zip(xs,xs[1:])))
        cols=list(range(xs[0],xs[-1]+1,step))
    else:
        cols=xs
    mat=[[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r,_ in special_rows]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(mat)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            block=[mat[i][j],mat[i][j+1],mat[i+1][j],mat[i+1][j+1]]
            row.append(block[0] if all(v==block[0] for v in block) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

# Build demo grids from their regular texture and horizontal marker rows.
def patterned(h,w, pattern, overrides):
    g=[[pattern[j%len(pattern)] for j in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r, base, vals in overrides:
        g[r]=[base]*w
        for c,v in vals.items(): g[r][c]=v
    return g
